project.title: Genomic analysis of microorganisms associated with a membrane bioreactor for wastewater treatment
project.description: Membrane bioreactors (MBRs) are highly effective for wastewater treatment, but membrane biofouling driven by microbial communities remains a major operational challenge. This overarching project aims to investigate the microbial community dynamics, symbiotic interactions, and the genomic potential for biofilm formation within the MBR ecosystem. We are conducting genomic analyses of diverse microorganisms derived from a lab-scale MBR treating wastewater. Sample sources encompass various niches within the system, including membrane-associated biofilms, bulk activated sludge, and specialized enrichment cultures. The comprehensive genomic resources generated through this ongoing project will provide valuable insights into the biological mechanisms driving biofouling and contribute to the optimization of wastewater treatment processes.
project.center_name: The Biomanufacturing Process Research Center, National Institute of Science and Technology
